originality.rationale: Defant (2015) posed exact closure component counts and settled only global density; its primary text has no r=3 endpoint table. The closest published exact count covers only r=2 (full RESULT.md inspected) and explicitly limits its scope. The r=3 theorem requires a distinct prime-tail argument, 32 rational local blocks and 18 exact gap certificates. Exhaustive novelty is not asserted.
residual_risks: Search-index coverage is incomplete: an independently derived unindexed exact r=3 decomposition might exist.
Nagura 1952 primary proof was not re-proved or fully inspected, but its standard bound is well established.

value.rationale: A complete exact topological classification at the first untreated integer parameter r=3: 19 intervals and 18 gaps, with an exact rational endpoint table, answer the naturally posed component-count problem of Defant 2015.
